name: mirage
text: Probe finished; real answers are saved (Release parlay-samples). What I learned: (1) The Pro key works: 100,000 credits, ~1,000 already used. (2) Live play-by-play SSE is real and fast (NHL events appear 0.1 s after they happen; each frame has score, period, clock and a play description), BUT for NBA/NHL/MLB/NFL its primary source is ESPN itself (primary_source: espn_nba/espn_nhl), so it is ESPN's data pushed instead of polled, a few seconds fresher than the scoreboard we poll, not a different truth. Tennis has no match live right now, so I could not see its source or frame shape yet. (3) Arbs: /arbitrage (pregame props, with Novig and Kalshi-type exchange legs flagged) and /inplay/arbs (live, 5 s) both work and return the two legs with books and odds. I will use them as leads for the Novig-Kalshi arb page. Plan, in order: (a) PBP stream as a live-score source behind ESPN, paper-checked against ESPN first; (b) arb leads; (c) record tennis PBP frames the next time tennis is live, then build a live tennis model with paper results BEFORE any real tennis auto bets or bids, since I have no tennis frame to build a model on yet; (d) judge consensus and line-movement from samples. Working on (a) now.
